18K likes, 58 comments - bharatzkitchen on September 30, 2026: "Haina Healthy Bhi Tasty Bhi 😁😁😁

Crispy outside, cheesy inside… aur shape bhi full mazedaar! 🧀🔥
Aaj bana rahe hain Cheese Stuffed Paratha Triangles — ek aisa quick snack jo breakfast, tiffin ya evening cravings, sabke liye perfect hai.
Aur is recipe ke liye maine use kiya MILLD High Protein Atta — toh regular paratha ko mila ek protein-packed upgrade - 46g protein in 3 parathas. 💪
Golden & crisp outside, soft atta layers aur beech mein gooey cheesy filling… ek triangle par rukna mushkil hai! 😋
Save karo, try karo aur batao — cheese pull kitna zabardast nikla? 👇

#bharatzkitchen #nashta #healthy #breakfast".
